text:
Priya S.: Hi all, excited to join! A few quick security/compliance Qs as I get set up: 1) I see a "Data Handling Questionnaire" in my onboarding checklist  is that mandatory and how detailed is it? 2) My corporate laptop delivery ETA is next Tue  can I use a loaner/home laptop meanwhile? 3) The phishing sim email referenced a "reporting workflow"  what exactly should I click or send? 4) For sandbox KMS access for a demo, do I need to complete the questionnaire first?

Mira (People Ops): Welcome Priya :tada: Short answers: yes the Data Handling Questionnaire is mandatory for engineers working with customer data; it's short (~8 questions). Loaner or BYOD allowed temporarily but must be enrolled in MDM and disk-encrypted. For phish sim, use the "Report Phish" button in mail or forward to phishing@redwood.infra. KMS access: we prefer the questionnaire done before granting sandbox roles.

Security Team: @Priya S. adding some details: the questionnaire checks whether you'll interact with PII, credentials, or payment data and instructs appropriate handling steps. It also attaches the Data Classification matrix. If you mark "access to PII", we'll require manager approval + a short screener call (5-10 min). For demos using synthetic or redacted data we can expedite sandbox `kms:DevSandboxDecrypt` once the questionnaire is submitted. Link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/data-questionnaire.

Priya S.: got it. If I use a personal Mac, what's the minimum I need to enable? Also is there a way to show proof of enrollment besides screenshots?

IT Helpdesk: @Priya S. For BYOD minimums: enable FileVault, install the Redwood MDM agent, and install Okta Verify or an approved MFA app. To show proof: run `fdesetup status` (macOS) or `manage-bde -status C:` (Windows) and paste output in the ticket. If you enroll via the MDM, the ticket will automatically show the device as managed in our console  include the device serial in the ticket. Loaner requests: open https://redwood.infra/tickets/new and choose "Loaner Device".

Priya S.: Thanks. Two more small things: 1) The questionnaire asks about "data residency"  what should I answer if my demo uses only synthetic data stored in GCP us-central1? 2) For the phish sim  will clicking the link mark me in any permanent way?

Security Team: For data residency, answer the cloud region you intend to use (us-central1) and mark "synthetic" under data type. That helps us avoid unnecessary escalation. For the phish sim, clicking a simulated link only records the event for training metrics and security coaching; it is not a disciplinary action. We anonymize most reports in aggregate. If you repeatedly fail sims we will follow up with additional training.

Mira (People Ops): I'll queue the questionnaire in your LMS so you can complete it today. Once you submit, tag your manager in the ticket so Security can fast-track sandbox access if appropriate.

Priya S.: Appreciate it. If I need a temporary MFA option other than my phone (e.g., desktop Authy), is that allowed? And if I need a YubiKey for prod later, how do I request one?

IT Helpdesk: Desktop Authy is acceptable on a personal device. For corporate-managed machines we prefer Okta Verify or hardware tokens. To request a YubiKey, open the ticket and choose "MFA hardware" and we'll ship one (priority new hires). Temporary soft-tokens can be requested as a stopgap and will auto-revoke.

Compliance Bot: Reminder: Data Handling Questionnaire due in 3 days. Please attach any supporting docs. Non-completion may delay sandbox or prod role provisioning.

Priya S.: One last scenario  if during a demo someone shares a screenshot that accidentally includes API keys, what is the immediate action?

Security Team: Good question. Immediately revoke the API key, rotate any credentials involved, disconnect shared sessions, and DM Security with a short timeline and the screenshot. We have an incident checklist for accidental secrets exposure and will guide remediation. No blame  focus on containment.

Priya S.: Thanks everyone, this is super helpful. I'll finish the questionnaire and paste `fdesetup status` into the ticket once my laptop arrives.

Mira (People Ops): Welcome again! Ping us if anything blocks. :rocket:
